column1: # Ondra, the Tideglass Queen, in Tolbi.

column3: Three kind hands, three\nshards of tide. Who wakes\nthe Queen of the Deep?{end_wait}
Who are you? You look like\nMia.{end_wait}
I'm Ondra. I drowned a\nkingdom to keep it safe.{page_break}The blade remembers me, so\nshow me you aren't fools.{end_wait}
I didn't come here to fight\nyou, but I won't run\neither.{end_wait}
